about_the_game:
Welcome to Elemental Towers – a fast-paced puzzle-action game in virtual reality, featuring epic battles against dragons in a mystical elemental realm.

Features:

  • Magical Towers: Your mission is to restore the ruined elemental towers across the realms of Water, Fire, Air, and Earth. Build your tower by closing rings and climbing ever higher. Each world has its own unique magical traits, offering distinct challenges to overcome.

  • Elemental Runes: Combine blocks and strategically place elemental runes to create powerful synergies that boost your tower in battle. Master the art of combinations to unlock devastating effects!

  • Dragon Battles: Defend your tower from the relentless fury of fearsome dragons. Outsmart your enemies with strategic thinking and precise execution to win every battle.

  • Epic Story About Elemental Magic! Dive into the ancient world of Elemar, uncovering its mysteries and restoring the elemental towers. Unlock new mechanics, abilities, and game modes as you progress! Explore misty swamps, frozen peaks, floating islands, and rivers of molten lava to bring harmony back to the world.

  • Global Leaderboard: Compete with players from around the world for the highest score and climb to the top of the rankings. Prove your mastery!

  • Campaign Mode. Embark on an immersive campaign to restore the broken world of Elemar.

  • Upcoming Multiplayer Mode. Face off in thrilling one-on-one duels. Real-time PvP battles are already in development!

    Act fast! Nature strikes back with force – floods, burning lava, heavy storms, and muddy swamps will keep you on your toes. The longer you play, the greater the danger.
